pyramiding_rule: Strict prohibition of adding units to losing sequences; pyramiding allowed only after primary position hits +$10.00 unearned profit threshold.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: ATR(14) expansion ratio must be below 1.5 relative to the 50-period mean to prevent high-impact news wick entry.
profit_harvest_threshold: Initiate scaling out and trailing stops aggressively the moment open profit crosses +$15.00 to lock in asymmetric gains.
